sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.9.25

  • Global Popover Mutex Engine: Added mutual exclusion checks across topbar punch menus, profile popovers, workspace cards, and notification panels. Prevents multiple popovers from opening simultaneously or overlapping.
  • Simplified Update Screen & Single Version Source: Fixed transient caching and update banner version sync. The Software Updates banner, toast notifications, and changelog timeline now display the exact same target version (e.g. v2.9.25) with dynamic accordion rendering.

2.9.24

  • Enforced Light Mode & Removed Appearance Toggles: Locked the platform design theme to clean Light Mode and removed Appearance toggle buttons from bottom sidebar admin popovers, topbar header menus, and authentication views.

2.9.23

  • Synced DB Attendance Punch System & Header Status Polish: Fully synchronized attendance punch status across server database records and header widgets. Features dynamic topbar status indicators (Punched In / Punch), fixed viewport popover positioning, and team attendance analytics.
  • New Version Feature Spotlight Card: Enhanced the Software Updates tab with mint-gradient spotlight banners, explicit version target comparisons, and dynamic live changelog mergers.

2.9.22

  • Synced DB Attendance Punch System: Integrated server-side attendance log state into the topbar Punch widget (cora_get_current_user_punch_status), automatically restoring punch status and timestamp across desktop and mobile headers upon page load.
  • Top Bar Punch Label Polish: Updated topbar punch button text to dynamically display Punched In (green dot) when checked in, and Punch (zinc dot) when checked out.
  • Fixed Viewport Popover Positioning: Resolved popover overflow cutoff bugs by updating mobile and desktop punch popover overlays to fixed viewport positioning (z-[999999]).
  • Team Attendance View Integration: Integrated team-wide attendance logs, GPS map verification, and automated CSV/PDF report generators inside the Users & Roles module.

2.9.21

  • New Version Feature Spotlight Card: Redesigned the update availability card into a high-impact mint gradient Feature Spotlight Card. Clearly highlights target version upgrades (e.g. v2.9.19 → v2.9.21), displays an embedded What's New in this Release feature summary box, and provides an instant header CTA button.
  • Dynamic Version Timeline Merger: Fixed changelog rendering logic so that checking for updates parses raw server HTML changelogs and dynamically merges all release versions (v2.9.21 down to v2.9.0) into the timeline with live icon highlighting.

2.9.20

  • Floating Sticky Action Bar & Live Upgrade Flow: Upgraded the Software Updates interface with viewport floating sticky action controls (sticky bottom-4 z-40 backdrop-blur-md), instant 1-click in-app update checking, and seamless live server shipment delivery.
  • Zero-Gap Collapsible Accordions: Improved version card collapse physics to eliminate bottom padding gaps when collapsed.

2.9.19

  • Viewport Floating Sticky Action Bar: Moved the bottom CTA action bar outside overflow-constrained card parents onto the section container (sticky bottom-4 z-40 backdrop-blur-md). The action bar now floats stickily near the bottom of the screen while scrolling through long release change logs.
